subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word which is nearest in meaning to the underlined word.**

One should **__follow__** role models in life.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Emulate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Follow" **means to obey or to act as ordered by someone, imitating someone as a role model. (किसी के आदेश का पालन करना या उसके अनुसार कार्य करना)

 
 
• **Example:** *I decided to **follow**__ her advice and go to bed early.*
 
 
 
• **"Emulate"** means to imitate or follow the example of someone as a role model. (किसी के बराबर होने या उससे आगे बढ़ने की चेष्‍टा करना)
 __
 
• **Example:** *Children should **emulate**__ their parents' good habits.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate word that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word is **"Emulate."**
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• **"Admire"** means to have a high opinion of someone or something. (किसी के प्रति आदर व प्रशंसा का भाव रखना; किसी को प्रिय दृष्टि से देखना)
 
• **"Cherish"** means to hold something dear or treasure it. (किसी से स्‍नेह करना और सावधानीपूर्वक देखरेख में रखना)
 
• **"Reward"** means to give something in return for good behaviour or effort. (किसी को पुरस्‍कार देना (अच्‍छा काम करने, परिश्रम करने आदि के लिए))
